title: B. Heller
summary: Editor of Sefer Lukow, the memorial book published in Tel Aviv in 1968 by former residents of Łuków in Israel and the United States. The available catalog information gives only the initial and surname; the full name remains to be verified from the original book.

editorialContent: B. Heller is identified by JewishGen as the editor of *Sefer Lukow; gehelikt der khorev gevorener kehile*, published in Tel Aviv in 1968. The editor's full given name is not established in the available translated catalog information.
